title: Working hours
subtitle: Assign working hours and follow the time every employee records

completed.label: Completed
completed.hint: Green — worked at least the assigned hours

short.label: Slightly short
short.hint: Orange — up to 15 minutes below the assigned hours

missing.label: Missing hours
missing.hint: Red — more than 15 minutes below the assigned hours

in_progress.label: In progress
in_progress.hint: Blue — clocked in now, or the shift is still running

not_started.label: Not started
not_started.hint: Gray — the shift hasn't ended and no time is recorded yet

no_schedule.label: No schedule
no_schedule.hint: Gray — no working hours are assigned for this day

editor.copyFirstHint: Give every working day the same hours as the first one

errors.required: Enter a start and an end time
errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start
errors.breakTooLong: The break is longer than the shift

custom.label: Custom hours
custom.hint: Set specific hours for each day

role_default.label: Role default
role_default.hint: Follow the default hours of their role

assign.effectiveHint: Past days keep the hours that applied at the time.
assign.confirmTitle_one: Confirm the new hours for {{count}} employee
assign.confirmTitle_other: Confirm the new hours for {{count}} employees
assign.replacesCustom_one: {{count}} employee currently has custom hours — they will be replaced.
assign.replacesCustom_other: {{count}} employees currently have custom hours — they will be replaced.

roles.title: Default hours by role
roles.subtitle: Every employee follows their role's default unless they have custom hours.
roles.resetAllHint: Remove custom hours so every employee in this role follows the default
roles.appliesTo_one: Applies automatically to {{count}} employee following this role.
roles.appliesTo_other: Applies automatically to {{count}} employees following this role.
roles.customKept_one: {{count}} employee with custom hours keeps them.
roles.customKept_other: {{count}} employees with custom hours keep them.
roles.removeConfirm_one: {{count}} employee will be left without a schedule. Click again to confirm.
roles.removeConfirm_other: {{count}} employees will be left without a schedule. Click again to confirm.

employees.title: Employee schedules
employees.subtitle: Select employees to assign hours in bulk, or edit one at a time.

review.label: Clock-out missing
review.hint: A time record was never clocked out. Open the employee to correct it.

records.clockOutHint: Leave empty if they are still working.
records.deleteMessage: This time will no longer count toward the employee's hours.

errors.outBeforeIn: The clock-out must be after the clock-in

detail.roleHasNoDefault: Their role has no default hours.

clock.clockedIn: Clocked in — have a good day
clock.stale: Your last clock-out was never recorded. Clock in to start today; HR can correct the earlier time.
